text: DSH Projects（DSH Desktop 插件）：把会话侧栏改为以项目为中心的浏览器，让相关对话按项目和工作目录归组。它在 Host 侧提供持久项目状态与会话目录切换接口，并将浏览器界面注册到工作区侧栏。用户可以创建和整理项目、搜索会话、为不同对话选择工作目录，也可清理空会话。适合希望按工作主题管理桌面会话的用户。需使用 DSH Host 提供的会话、工作区和目录服务；项目状态保存在本机 DSH 数据目录。

DSH Projects is a DSH Desktop plugin that groups conversations into projects in the sidebar. Users can organize projects, search conversations, and choose a working directory per conversation. Its Host side stores project state locally and applies directory changes through DSH services.
想把桌面版 DSH 的对话按不同项目分组管理。
我希望每个会话都能选自己的工作目录，并随时切换。
I want to search my conversations and organize them into project groups in the DSH sidebar.
DSH Projects 的功能「项目化会话侧栏」：将工作区侧栏替换为项目浏览器，按项目及目录展示相关会话，并提供会话搜索和项目管理入口。
DSH Projects 的功能「每会话工作目录」：用户可在会话操作菜单中选择或更改工作目录；界面通过 Host 的目录服务应用切换。

@wxysskd/dsh-projects README · dsh-projects：[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@wxysskd/dsh-projects) [](LICENSE)

Claude-Desktop-style **Projects** for **DSH Desktop** (the `desktop` DSH profile
only — Web and headless profiles are untouched).

The shipped DSH sidebar groups conversations by Workspace (directory). This
plugin replaces that sidebar region with a project-first browser:

@wxysskd/dsh-projects README · dsh-projects：- create **projects** (name, color, one or more working directories);
- every conversation lives inside a project;
- **each conversation can use a different directory**, chosen when it is
  created (or switched later through *Change working directory*), backed by the
  Host's real `workingDirectory` service — the same durable, model-visible
  mechanism as the `working_directory` tool;
- sessions outside any project stay visible under **Other conversations**,
  still grouped by Workspace, so nothing is lost;
- **empty conversations are hidden and can be deleted for real**: the Host keeps
  reusable blank Sessions from every "New Session" click (`blank: true`); only
  the empty Session that is currently open is shown. The Host also scans legacy
  Sessions whose catalog row is not marked blank but whose log contains no
  conversation events at all (only tiny header/metadata logs are inspected), so
  old "Badstuff"-style empty chats are hidden too. *View options → Delete empty
  conversations (N)* permanently removes both kinds from disk through a
  validated Host route (never touches a conversation with content; sessions
  still live in the

user adds. This repository publishes a format-1 index with a commit-pinned Git
install target:

Add that URL as an index source in **Plugins → Discover** and install
**Projects** from the card; the same index is readable by the `plugin_market`
tool and by any other DSH Desktop user:

@wxysskd/dsh-projects README · Plugin market (Discover tab)：The market entry installs the published npm package
(`@wxysskd/dsh-projects@<version>`), the same artifact as the tarball. See
[market/README.md](market/README.md) for the format and how to regenerate it
(`npm run market`). Installing from the market still needs one app restart for
the Host row.

@wxysskd/dsh-projects README · Data：| Method | Path | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/dsh-projects/state` | complete project state |
| GET | `/dsh-projects/health` | liveness + counts |
| POST | `/dsh-projects/mutate` | `project.create`, `project.update`, `project.delete`, `session.assign` |
| POST | `/dsh-projects/cwd` | change one conversation's working directory |
| POST | `/dsh-projects/purge` | permanently remove validated empty sessions (rejects content) |
| GET | `/dsh-projects/empty-sessions` | list sessions that hold no conversation content |

@wxysskd/dsh-projects README · Data：POST routes require `content-type: application/json` and `x-dsh-projects: 1`
and a 64 KiB body limit.

@wxysskd/dsh-projects README · Build：```
npm install          # dev-only: esbuild, react, react-dom, playwright
node scripts/build.mjs   # src/client/* -> client.js (committed artifact)
npm run pack             # build + dist/<name>-<version>.tgz + SHA-256 + manifest
node harness/build.mjs   # mock harness bundle

@wxysskd/dsh-projects README · Design notes：- The browser entry registers into the shipped `sidebar.workspaces` single slot
  at `priority: -1`, shadowing `ui-workspace`'s browser. The shipped entry stays
  registered underneath: if our component crashes, its entry is abdicated and
  the original sidebar comes back.
- The client bundle imports only `react` / `react-dom` / `react/jsx-runtime`
  from the shell's shared module table and uses `ctx` services for everything
  else (`sessions`, `workspaces`, `uiWorkspace`, `locale`, `slots`).
- Styles use `--dsw-*` theme tokens; literals are limited to project accent
  artwork. All classes are prefixed `pj-`.

@wxysskd/dsh-projects README · Moving workspaces and conversations between projects：Everything can be migrated without deleting or recreating sessions, through the
project metadata only (session logs are never touched):
section: Moving workspaces and conversations between projects

text:
@wxysskd/dsh-projects README · Moving workspaces and conversations between projects：- **Drag a conversation row** onto any project section → the session is assigned
  to that project (drag it onto *Other conversations* to remove it from its
  project).
- **Drag a workspace group header** (under *Other conversations*) onto any
  project section → the directory moves into that project (removed from any
  other project's directory list, never duplicated) and every conversation in
  that directory is assigned to it. While dragging, every project shows a
  dashed drop outline and the hovered target is highlighted.
- **Menu path** (same result without dragging):
  - workspace group `⋯` → *Move workspace to project* → pick the target;
  - project `⋯` → *Move working directory to another project…* → pick the
    directory → pick the target project (or *Remove from project (back to Other
    conversations)*);
  - conversation `⋯` → *Move to project* → pick the target (or *No project*).
section: Moving workspaces and conversations between projects
Moving workspaces and conversations between projects

@wxysskd/dsh-projects README · Moving workspaces and conversations between projects：Workspace headers (both inside projects and under *Other conversations*) expose
their own menu: **Rename workspace…**, **Move workspace to project**, **Remove
from project** and **Delete workspace**. Deleting a workspace removes only its
registration, puts its conversations back under *Other conversations*, and never
deletes a conversation.
section: Moving workspaces and conversations between projects

@wxysskd/dsh-projects README · 0.2.1-rc.5: standing subagent settings vs. preset scope：rc.5 mounts `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent/model-selection-settings` as a
*standing* row while its presets request `modelSelectionSettings: true` inside a
preset scope, so every session whose recorded preset carries the flag fails with
`agent-preset/invalid` and renders without a live composer. Fixed upstream in
0.2.2 (the flag is gone); apply `scripts/fix-rc5-session-unavailable.mjs` only on
rc.5, and `--remove` it after upgrading:
section: 0.2.1-rc.5: standing subagent settings vs. preset scope

text:

node scripts/fix-rc5-session-unavailable.mjs --presets <app>/dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app/presets
node scripts/fix-rc5-session-unavailable.mjs --remove    # after upgrading
```
section: 0.2.1-rc.5: standing subagent settings vs. preset scope

text:
@wxysskd/dsh-projects README · After upgrading to 0.2.2: a leftover rc.5 workaround breaks the new presets：0.2.2 genuinely fixed the upstream bug — its shipped presets no longer contain
`modelSelectionSettings` (verified: 0 occurrences in `dsh-web-app/presets`).
The regression right after the update came from the **rc.5 workaround still
being applied**: the preset override block restated the *old* preset definitions,
so it replaced 0.2.2's presets with rc.5 wiring. On 0.2.2 the stale
`tool-subagent-control/list-agents` row never starts and session creation fails:
section: After upgrading to 0.2.2: a leftover rc.5 workaround breaks the new presets

text:
@wxysskd/dsh-projects README · After upgrading to 0.2.2: a leftover rc.5 workaround breaks the new presets：```
agent-preset/invalid — tool-subagent-list-agents
(@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent-control/list-agents): never started
```

which the conversation view renders as "Session unavailable" again. Measured by
booting 0.2.2-rc.1 against a profile copy: stale block + old packages → create
fails with the error above; stale packages alone → create succeeds.

Therefore the workaround must be removed when the runtime no longer needs it:
section: After upgrading to 0.2.2: a leftover rc.5 workaround breaks the new presets

text:
@wxysskd/dsh-projects README · After upgrading to 0.2.2: a leftover rc.5 workaround breaks the new presets：```bash
node scripts/fix-rc5-session-unavailable.mjs --remove   # idempotent
```

The script also refuses to apply when the shipped presets carry no
`modelSelectionSettings` flag, so it cannot be re-applied on 0.2.2+.
section: After upgrading to 0.2.2: a leftover rc.5 workaround breaks the new presets

text:
@wxysskd/dsh-projects README · Old `@deepseek-ai/*` copies left in the profile after an update：Independently, packages older than the app that sit in
`~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/node_modules` shadow the copies bundled in the app.
A stale `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent` (0.2.1-rc.5 inside a 0.2.2 runtime) is
declared incompatible, so `tool-subagent`, `tool-subagent-fork` and
`subagent-model-selection-settings` get disabled and the delegation tools go
missing; bundles pinned to the old version (`dsh-subagent-codex`,
`dsh-subagent-claude-code`, …) are skipped. Session creation still works, but
subagent features silently disappear.
section: Old `@deepseek-ai/*` copies left in the profile after an update

text:
@wxysskd/dsh-projects README · Old `@deepseek-ai/*` copies left in the profile after an update：Fix: move the stale copies out of the profile so the app's matching versions are
resolved, then restart:

```bash
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>
mkdir -p .removed-stale-$(date +%Y%m%d)
mv node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent \
   node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-brand \
   node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-sdk-protocol \
   .removed-stale-$(date +%Y%m%d)/ 2>/dev/null
section: Old `@deepseek-ai/*` copies left in the profile after an update

integration surfaces intact:

| --- | --- | --- |
| `dsh-timeline` | DOM-injects its starred-folder section before `[data-slot="sidebar.workspaces"]`; resolves session rows as `div[role="treeitem"][aria-selected]`; injects "Star Chat to Folder" into host menus found as `body > [role="menu"]` | Works: the slot anchor is preserved (its folder section renders above Projects), every row follows the shipped treeitem/title DOM contract, and menus/modals are portaled to `document.body`, so its injected menu item appears and opens its own dialog |
| `dsh-cost-meter` | Registers `sidebar.footer.action` entries and styles its own footer stack | Works unchanged: footer actions are outside the replaced region |
| `dsh-notification`, `dsh-plugin` (hub), `dsh-thoughtdag`, `dsh-dafeiyu`, `dsh-plugin-whale-pet` | No `sidebar.workspaces` DOM or row-slot usage (audited client bundles) | No interaction |
| shipped `ui-workspace` browser | Registers the slot at priority 0; its child row-extension slots (e.g. schedule marks) are only rendered by its own component | Our entry shadows it at priority -1; if o

@wxysskd/dsh-projects README · Compatibility with other sidebar plugins：Live verification with `dsh-timeline` + `dsh-cost-meter` + Projects mounted in one
real DSH host: our sidebar rendered 57/57 sessions as timeline-compatible
treeitems, timeline's starred-folder section appeared above Projects, timeline's
"Star Chat to Folder" item was injected into our session menu and opened its
dialog, cost-meter's footer card rendered normally, our menus/search stayed
functional, and the browser console reported no errors.

@wxysskd/dsh-projects README · Known limits (v1)：- The shipped `ui-workspace` browser's child extension slots
  (`sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item`, `sidebar.session.row.leading`, …) are
  not rendered by our browser, so shipped/third-party row decorations registered
  there (for example the schedule mark) do not appear while it is active. The
  shipped built-in session actions are re-implemented directly in the project
  menus, and `dsh-timeline`'s DOM-based decorations do work (see above).
- Global shortcuts owned by `ui-workspace` (Cmd+N / Cmd+K) keep their shipped
  behavior; our search field is opened through the header icon.
- Collapsed sections, archived filter and the last viewed state are stored in
  the browser's `localStorage`; project data lives Host-side.
- The empty-Session scan and permanent deletion run through the Host half, so a
  client bundle that hot-reloads before the Host half does cannot see them: the
  scan is skipped and the cleanup falls back to archiving blank Sessions, telling
  the user to restart the app once. After that restart the sidebar hides legacy
  empty chats automatically and the same menu entry deletes them from disk.

Claude-Desktop-style **Projects** for **DSH Desktop** (the `desktop` DSH profile

The shipped DSH sidebar groups conversations by Workspace (directory). This

@wxysskd/dsh-projects README · dsh-projects：- create **projects** (name, color, one or more working directories);
- every conversation lives inside a project;
- **each conversation can use a different directory**, chosen when it is
  created (or switched later through *Change working directory*), backed by the

  mechanism as the `working_directory` tool;
- sessions outside any project stay visible under **Other conversations**,
  still grouped by Workspace, so nothing is lost;

  reusable blank Sessions from every "New Session" click (`blank: true`); only
  the empty Session that is currently open is shown. The Host also scans legacy
  Sessions whose catalog row is not marked blank but whose log contains no
  conversation events at all (only tiny header/metadata logs are inspected), so
  old "Badstuff"-style empty chats are hidden too. *View options → Delete empty
  conversations (N)* permanently removes both kinds from disk through a
  validated Host route (never touches a conversation with content; sessions
  still live in the

@wxysskd/dsh-projects README · Plugin market (Discover tab)：The market entry installs the published npm package
(`@wxysskd/dsh-projects@<version>`), the same artifact as the tarball. See

@wxysskd/dsh-projects README · Data：| Method | Path | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/dsh-projects/state` | complete project state |
| GET | `/dsh-projects/health` | liveness + counts |
| POST | `/dsh-projects/mutate` | `project.create`, `project.update`, `project.delete`, `session.assign` |
| POST | `/dsh-projects/cwd` | change one conversation's working directory |
| POST | `/dsh-projects/purge` | permanently remove validated empty sessions (rejects content) |
| GET | `/dsh-projects/empty-sessions` | list sessions that hold no conversation content |

@wxysskd/dsh-projects README · Data：POST routes require `content-type: application/json` and `x-dsh-projects: 1`
and a 64 KiB body limit.

@wxysskd/dsh-projects README · Build：```
npm install          # dev-only: esbuild, react, react-dom, playwright
node scripts/build.mjs   # src/client/* -> client.js (committed artifact)
npm run pack             # build + dist/<name>-<version>.tgz + SHA-256 + manifest
node harness/build.mjs   # mock harness bundle

@wxysskd/dsh-projects README · Design notes：- The browser entry registers into the shipped `sidebar.workspaces` single slot
  at `priority: -1`, shadowing `ui-workspace`'s browser. The shipped entry stays
  registered underneath: if our component crashes, its entry is abdicated and
  the original sidebar comes back.
- The client bundle imports only `react` / `react-dom` / `react/jsx-runtime`
  from the shell's shared module table and uses `ctx` services for everything
  else (`sessions`, `workspaces`, `uiWorkspace`, `locale`, `slots`).
- Styles use `--dsw-*` theme tokens; literals are limited to project accent
  artwork. All classes are prefixed `pj-`.

@wxysskd/dsh-projects README · Moving workspaces and conversations between projects：Everything can be migrated without deleting or recreating sessions, through the
project metadata only (session logs are never touched):
section: Moving workspaces and conversations between projects

text:
@wxysskd/dsh-projects README · Moving workspaces and conversations between projects：- **Drag a conversation row** onto any project section → the session is assigned
  to that project (drag it onto *Other conversations* to remove it from its
  project).
- **Drag a workspace group header** (under *Other conversations*) onto any
  project section → the directory moves into that project (removed from any
  other project's directory list, never duplicated) and every conversation in
  that directory is assigned to it. While dragging, every project shows a
  dashed drop outline and the hovered target is highlighted.
- **Menu path** (same result without dragging):
  - workspace group `⋯` → *Move workspace to project* → pick the target;
  - project `⋯` → *Move working directory to another project…* → pick the
    directory → pick the target project (or *Remove from project (back to Other
    conversations)*);
  - conversation `⋯` → *Move to project* → pick the target (or *No project*).

```

@wxysskd/dsh-projects README · After upgrading to 0.2.2: a leftover rc.5 workaround breaks the new presets：0.2.2 genuinely fixed the upstream bug — its shipped presets no longer contain
`modelSelectionSettings` (verified: 0 occurrences in `dsh-web-app/presets`).
The regression right after the update came from the **rc.5 workaround still
being applied**: the preset override block restated the *old* preset definitions,
so it replaced 0.2.2's presets with rc.5 wiring. On 0.2.2 the stale
`tool-subagent-control/list-agents` row never starts and session creation fails:
section: After upgrading to 0.2.2: a leftover rc.5 workaround breaks the new presets

text:

agent-preset/invalid — tool-subagent-list-agents
(@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent-control/list-agents): never started
```

which the conversation view renders as "Session unavailable" again. Measured by
booting 0.2.2-rc.1 against a profile copy: stale block + old packages → create
fails with the error above; stale packages alone → create succeeds.

Therefore the workaround must be removed when the runtime no longer needs it:
section: After upgrading to 0.2.2: a leftover rc.5 workaround breaks the new presets

```

The script also refuses to apply when the shipped presets carry no
`modelSelectionSettings` flag, so it cannot be re-applied on 0.2.2+.
